summary: Ubuntu 15.10 (Wily Werewolf) was released on 22 October 2015. Features: LibreOffice 5.0, Python 3.5, improved snap package format (snapd). First release where Canonical began serious push for snaps as universal packages. The werewolf evoked cunning and transformation.
notes: Unsupported since 2016-07-28. Kernel 4.2. Early snap support; Flatpak later became more widely adopted outside Ubuntu.
